title: Frigidaire 35 Pint Smart Dehumidifier

writeup: Woot has a new Frigidaire Gallery 35-pint smart dehumidifier (model GHDD3535W1, UPC 012505285776) for $138.99. Frigidaire's own US store lists the matching white GHDD3535W1 in stock at $299. That is about 53 percent below the manufacturer's current price and saves about $160. The unit includes air quality monitoring and a MERV 14 filter. Woot showed 10+ left with a limit of 10 per customer.
